changelog: Overhauled Chat Input Bar UI/UX to match Antigem: added dedicated Speech-to-Text Live Dictation Waveform button alongside the signature white Voice Note mic button.
Streamlined Model Selector Pill: fixed artificial width restrictions, allowing model names to display cleanly without truncation while preserving the quota percentage badge and dropdown arrow.
Enhanced Quota Indicator: dark pine green pill badge displaying real-time remaining quota percentage (e.g. 93%) with robust model family fallback matching.
Dynamic Input Placeholder: context-aware placeholder ('Reply to Gemini...', 'Reply to Claude...') reflecting active model.
